limitations: Derived warm full-system time = actual mean main-anchor receipt wall + median steady full predict/batch; not a direct joint timing or a quantile of joint latency.
First Action load + first inference is object cold in a warm process/filesystem, not true process/disk cold.
Runtime replicates use one fixed training seed and same parents; no cross-seed pseudo-independence.
CPU/MPS wall are not priced or device-utilization equivalents; no total economic break-even is identified.
Physical instrumentation sub-operation timers overlap with enclosing job wall and must not be summed with it.
